text:
Both **Monzo** and **Starling** are full UK banks regulated by the PRA/FCA with FSCS protection (guarding your deposits up to £85,000). Neither has physical branches, but both are vastly better than traditional high-street banking apps.

Choosing between them depends on what matters most: **Monzo** is superior for day-to-day budgeting and social features, while **Starling** is better for travel, everyday practicality (cash/cheques), and customer service.

---

### Quick Comparison

| Feature | Monzo (Free Account) | Starling Bank |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Card spending abroad** | Free (Mastercard exchange rate) | Free (Mastercard exchange rate) |
| **Overseas ATM withdrawals** | Free in the EEA; £200/month limit outside EEA (3% fee thereafter) | **Fee-free worldwide** (up to £300/day limit) |
| **Cash deposits** | PayPoint (**£1 fee per deposit**, limit £300/time) | **Post Office** (Free up to £1,000/year, then 0.7%) |
| **Cheque deposits** | In-app photo (up to £500; post for larger) | In-app photo (up to £1,000) |
| **Web / Desktop access** | Emergency-only web portal | **Full online banking portal** via browser |
| **Customer support** | In-app chat (phone line for emergencies) | **24/7 in-app chat & phone support** |
| **Virtual cards** | Behind paid tiers (from £3/mo) | **Free** (link up to 5 to your Spaces) |
| **Early payday** | **Yes** (claim BACS salary at 4 pm day before) | No (credits automatically on due date) |

---

### Where Monzo Wins

1. **King of Budgeting & UI:** Monzo’s app is energetic, intuitive, and granular. You can categorize transactions automatically, set spending limits per category, and view upcoming recurring commitments clearly.
2. **Social Banking:** If your friends, flatmates, or partner use Monzo, features like "Shared Tabs," splitting bills, and instant peer-to-peer transfers are seamless.
3. **Paid a Day Early:** If your employer pays by standard BACS, Monzo detects this and lets you withdraw your pay at 4:00 PM the working day before it is technically due.
4. **Subscription Perks:** Monzo offers tiered paid plans (Extra, Perks, Max) if you want bundled travel/phone insurance, RAC breakdown cover, or packaged lifestyle perks.

---

### Where Starling Wins

1. **Traveling Outside Europe:** While both offer fee-free card spending abroad, Starling does not penalise you for cash withdrawals outside Europe. Monzo imposes a £200 rolling limit before charging a 3% fee, whereas Starling lets you withdraw up to £300 daily worldwide without fees.
2. **Better Practical Banking (Cash & Cheques):** 
   * Depositing cash with Starling is handled free at any **Post Office** counter (up to £1,000/year). Monzo uses **PayPoint** (corner shops) and charges you £1 each time
